headline: 2008 order expands US sanctions tied to Syria by freezing property of more people and groups.
what_it_does: This order adds to an existing national emergency regarding Syria. It allows the US government to block, or freeze, property and interests in property in the United States of additional people and organizations linked to that emergency. Blocked property generally cannot be transferred, paid out, or used. Only the title was provided, so the specific groups targeted and the reasons are not detailed here.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations named or covered under the order
who_it_affects.how: Any of their property or assets under US control can be frozen.
They are generally barred from dealing in property or assets that have been blocked under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 13, 2008; exact effective date not stated in the provided material.
